title: rdev Fleet inventory schema 1 (administrator CAS update)
description: Shape contract; broker additionally validates canonical target identities, case-fold label collisions, global uniqueness, tombstones and revision CAS before atomic publication. Persistent snapshots contain nonempty IDs/digests and every record field.

host_id.description: Empty for a new broker-generated identity; supplied IDs must be active and retain target identity.

items.description: Case-sensitive ASCII bytes 0x21..0x7e excluding comma, equals and ampersand; broker validates canonical trusted registry membership.

target_digest.description: May be omitted for new records; broker derives and verifies canonical connection identity.

retired_ids.description: Broker-maintained permanent tombstones; clients cannot replace this history.
